text:
alice.partnerships: Quick heads up — I'm drafting a private-offer framework for AWS/Azure marketplace. Need input on renewal-tier laddering, hardware partner SKUs, and SI carve-outs. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c
jamie.sales: Love it. Are we keeping the 12/24/36 month commit bands?
rory.revenue: +1 to bands but suggest adding a 'spend smoothing' option for SI deals (allows commit to be met across multiple invoices)
sana.ops: For renewals we need a 'no-backdate' clause for usage reconciliation. Also requires clear KMS entitlement mapping.
devon.ce: Hardware partners will demand SKU-level attribution. Proposed mapping snippet:
```
SKU_RED_DED_01 -> hostpool:gpuA
SKU_HW_BUNDLE_50 -> partner:partnerX:installed
SKU_ONPREM_10 -> license:node-10
```
lucy.finance: Recommend capping first-term discount at 30%. Add step-down at renewal: 30% -> 20% -> 10% unless customer ups the commit.
jamie.sales: Can we add a one-time promo (first-12mo) bump for SI-led closes? It improves close rate on larger ARR.
alice.partnerships: Good call. Also proposing a partial-fulfillment fallback: if partner can't deliver hardware in 90 days, customer gets hosted-credit equal to 60% of committed value until delivery. Thoughts?
rory.revenue: 60% fallback seems okay, but tie to SLA windows and legal review. Also include a usage reconciliation window (30 days) on renewal.
pricing-bot: scan complete — flagged: "renewal_discount_floor" missing from draft. Action: @alice.partnerships to add a minimum discount field and renewal cadence.
alice.partnerships: I'll update the doc tonight with discount floor + fallback language. Can folks drop contract language snippets or past SI term sheets here?
jamie.sales: I'll paste two recent SI termsheet clauses into the doc tomorrow morning.
sana.ops: tagging infra to validate SKU mapping for on-prem installs: @devon.ce please confirm kernel/driver dependencies.
alice.partnerships: Thanks — will incorporate. If anyone has hardware partner carve-out examples (revenue splits, OEM pass-through) drop them in.
jamie.sales: FYI — partnerX wants a rev share only after hardware install verification.
lucy.finance: Also note: billing ops prefer renewals to transition from committed prepaid to monthly invoiced over a 3-month ramp to avoid cash shock.
alice.partnerships: Noted. I'll add a 'ramp-to-monthly' clause option. Thanks all :thumbsup:
